system:
You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

Case: SHARP NCT00125593 - Study of Heart and Renal Protection | mode: autopsy | as_of: 2010-11-20
Drug: simvastatin (HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor)

Verdict: {"outcome": "success", "outcome_basis": "readout: \"VYTORIN (ezetimibe/simvastatin) Significantly Reduced Major Vascular Events in Patients With Chronic Kidney Disease in a New 9,000-Patient I\" (announcement:sharp)", "predicted_outcome": "success", "consistency": "consistent with the calculator (probability of success 98%)", "primary_category": "robust_success", "secondary_categories": [], "calculator_category": "robust_success", "confidence": "high", "verification": "done", "probability_of_success": 0.981, "weakest_link": "target genetics: uncertain"}
Calculator: {"case_id": "sharp", "ldl_equivalent_mmol": 0.83, "basis": "LDL-C", "time_factor": 0.988, "expected_hr": 0.816, "causal_rrr": 0.184, "bp_factor": 1.0, "power": 0.981, "mde_hr_80": 0.868, "outcome": "success", "category": "robust_success", "secondary": [], "weakest_link": "target genetics: uncertain", "consistent_with_observed": null, "assumptions": [], "notes": []}
Hypotheses: {"hypotheses": [{"category": "robust_success", "status": "supported", "for": [{"text": "Primary endpoint met with high significance (p=0.001) and HR 0.839, well below 1", "refs": ["f_0c602e8810ee83", "f_6dcb721908b6db"]}, {"text": "Observed HR (0.839) closely matches mechanism-predicted HR (0.816) from 0.83 mmol/L LDL-C reduction", "refs": ["calculator", "f_1e0081604972e1", "f_87b72a90517edc"]}, {"text": "Trial was highly powered (98%) with 1562 events over 4.9 years median follow-up", "refs": ["calculator", "f_4120933dee2d16", "f_334b6a830c3302", "f_7158a7b5677540"]}, {"text": "No safety signal offsetting benefit: cancer incidence and mortality balanced vs placebo", "refs": ["f_2ef9d02553c764"]}, {"text": "Placebo-controlled design with adequate follow-up for atherosclerotic events in CKD population", "refs": ["f_ca302c91af3673", "f_b2b2f16890fcc6", "f_b5e73de7723e05"]}], "against": [{"text": "Target genetics rated 'uncertain' because all HMGCR genetic evidence published after 2010-11-20 cutoff", "refs": ["f_53f9433e84f158", "calculator"]}], "would_settle": "Pre-cutoff HMGCR genetic evidence (now available) confirms target causality; this is a data-availability artifact, not a biological weakness"}, {"category": "success_with_caveats", "status": "weakened", "for": [{"text": "Target genetics formally 'uncertain' per calculator cutoff rule", "refs": ["f_53f9433e84f158", "calculator"]}, {"text": "Drug is fixed-dose combination (simvastatin + ezetimibe); post-cutoff evidence confirms causality", "refs": ["f_53f9433e84f158"]}, {"text": "LDL-C lowering mechanism validated by multiple prior statin trials (HPS, 4S, etc.)", "refs": ["f_574bdd5f3caf62", "f_8e7443c070ee7c", "f_fd660180465880"]}], "would_settle": "Pre-2010 HMGCR Mendelian randomization studies (now published) would resolve the cutoff artifact"}, {"category": "population", "status": "weakened", "for": [{"text": "CKD population has high competing non-vascular mortality;
